review_findings.summary: Candidate identity could change between caller validation and publication lock acquisition.
review_findings.resolution: Commit 08d2ba1d pins expected_candidate_id and revalidates the candidate inside the stable publication lock; Generation and KBase publishers pass the pinned identity.

review_findings.summary: Promotion recovery covered only part of the rename matrix and rollback had no durable recovery journal.
review_findings.resolution: Commits 9980f46c through 216c75ff add pending-write blocking, intent journals, promotion and rollback crash matrices, commit-point-consistent forward recovery, strict identity checks, disk-full cleanup, and fail-closed corrupt-state handling.

review_findings.summary: Removing and recreating the publication lock could split lock ownership across different inodes.
review_findings.resolution: Commit 28f3813e keeps one stable OS lock file and the regression suite verifies its identity across promote and rollback operations.

review_findings.summary: Catalog validation accepted structurally valid content and facet tampering while retaining the old publication identity.
review_findings.resolution: Commits fba76b68 and ca4a1db2 recompute catalog source identity and facets, bind catalog_version to content, use the full source fingerprint internally, and pin candidate identity during publication.

review_findings.summary: Semantic rollback still used an unjournaled second three-rename implementation.
review_findings.resolution: Commit 9c9a3b62 routes semantic rollback through ImmutableReleaseStore and proves recovery after a hard crash at the first slot move.

review_findings.summary: A bare reader can observe CURRENT absent during the directory swap.
review_findings.resolution: The guarantee is explicitly limited to writer crash consistency in T1; compliant reader visibility is assigned to P2R1-T2 read leases and fencing, avoiding a pointer-framework expansion.

codex_cli_attempts.scope: parallel split release and generation/KBase reviews
